records.name: Over here, you idiot...
findings: Official anniversary documentation confirms the Masked Saiyan Lite event.
Repeated raid schedules document this Super Soul as an individual-performance reward.
Current catalogue supports +20% stamina recovery and +25% all attacks for 10 seconds; historical categorical labels differ, so they are not converted into numeric values.

records.name: Bye-bye, universe!
findings: Official anniversary documentation lists this Super Soul as a 50,000-damage individual-performance reward in the Fused Zamasu event.
Current catalogue corroborates approximately 0.5% HP/sec auto-reduction below 25% Health and deactivation when the wearer is KO'ed.

policy: Canonical data remains authoritative; secondary evidence is used for provenance and reconciliation, and conflicting categorical labels remain preserved.
